messages:
Asha: Noticed p99 spike on /v1/generate right after rollout. p50/p95 steady, p99 up ~300ms for 10m.
Ben: Any split by region/variant?
Asha: Green variant + EU. Sampled spans point to routing and proxy_decode. Model unchanged.
Sam: Console only shows total & model. We should surface per-stage p50/p95/p99.
Ben: If spans sampled independently p99 will be noisy. Propose agent emits per-request map {ingress_ms,routing_ms,decode_ms,infer_ms,total_ms,sample_origin,rollout_id}.
Asha: UI: add 'Per-stage percentiles' toggle and a coverage badge if maps cover <80%.
Sam: For retries, maps should be summed per logical request. If no map, fallback to span-join and mark 'partial'.
metrics-bot: filed TASK-9991 to track agent RFC and TASK-9992 for rollout-overlay.
Ben: I'll prototype /internal/telemetry/stage-quantiles endpoint that returns stage rows with p50/p95/p99 + coverage flag.
Asha: Timeline: RFC by Thu, prototype API next week, console toggle after coverage validated. Ping here with rollout weight timeline if you see more spikes.
